$comment: Hand-off of architecture §7.3 of wave3-optimization (E1.F11.T5): the project-upgrade steps the Wave 3 components need, in the catalogue's field shape (id, since, title, check, fix, dry_run, human, risk, report_only, cost) plus component, the check/fix descriptions, the release line and status. DECLARATIONS ONLY: no function named here exists yet; `since` is a placeholder fixed at release. Once project-upgrade and this change are both on the main branch, a follow-up change turns the rows into catalogue entries. Until then the CHANGELOG release block carries them as a manual Upgrade list.

steps.title: Move the tracker's client tag into the first-level client
steps.check_reads: spec.json / project.json with a non-empty `clickup.client_tag` and no `client`
steps.fix_does: write `client` = the tag (the `validate --fix` proposal); the tag stays as the read fallback

steps.title: Report a client that differs from its tracker tag
Declare the stakeholders the sponsor page and events need
steps.check_reads: project.json without `stakeholders` while the PRDs name a sponsor
steps.fix_does: none: print a snippet from the latest PRD Stakeholders section for the human

steps.title: Report cost-limit keys (measured, never capped)
steps.check_reads: project.json keys matching the cost-limit list (the Wave 2 `judges.budget` included)
steps.fix_does: none by default; removal only when the human accepts the shown diff (D-30)

steps.title: Say when effort cannot be measured
steps.check_reads: the project's statusline is not the plugin's (no cost capture possible)
steps.fix_does: none: effort will read `n/a — statusline not installed`

steps.title: Add the WSJF columns to the backlog
steps.fix_does: add the empty columns (the items become `unscored`); the diff is shown first

steps.title: Report backlog rows closed without a change or commit
steps.check_reads: rows in state `done` without a change or a commit

steps.title: Neutral incident states (localized names stay valid)
steps.fix_does: none (aliases accepted); an optional rewrite to the neutral names shown as a diff

steps.title: Declare the project's time zone
steps.check_reads: rules or project docs naming a fixed zone, and no `time_zone`
steps.fix_does: none: report the lines and suggest `project.json:time_zone`

steps.title: Report team settings that do not validate
steps.fix_does: none: the failing keys are named

steps.title: Seed the project design system
steps.fix_does: propose a seed from the latest design-spec tokens (a diff the human accepts)

steps.title: Report tracker items in the 4.0 shape
steps.check_reads: tracker items as phase-Features, QA or deploy items at the root

steps.title: Report a project whose specs live under spec/
steps.check_reads: the project keeps its specs under `spec/`
steps.fix_does: none: it is found now; reported for the record

no_step_needed: size tool, core, load lists, adapters, references, orchestrator, generated blocks (C-01..C-08): plugin-side
effort record, sponsor page, report, events, questions and risk register (C-09, C-13..C-17): new optional artifacts created on first use
contrast tool and design judge: plugin-side
